1 Specification
1.1 General Specification

         Title                              Info

     Master Chip      ESP32D0/ ESP32S3, Xtensa32 dual core processor

       HashRate       1000+KH/s(ESP32D0WD)，380+KH/s(ESP32S3)

        Wi-Fi         802.11 b/g/n, up to 150Mbps

  Device management   NMController/NMMiner Monitor

   Firmware upgrade   NM Flash ESPTool（flash.nmminer.com）

    Power Interface   Type-C USB

     Supply mode      USB

  Power Consumption   0.5~1W

 Operating Temperature -20 ~ 70 ℃

2 Get Start
2.1 Prepare
 Remove the film on the surface of the acrylic（if need）.
 Your home wifi name.
 Your home wifi password.
 Your BTC address.

2.2 Buttons ( NM-CYD / ESP32-2432S028)

     Buttons            Action                      Description
       boot          Double click               Switch to next page
       boot           Long press                Force configuration
      reset              Click                  Reset the NMMiner




  *The board's external I/O ports and TF slot will be used next NMMiner version.

2 Configuration
2.1 When powered on, the miner will first try to reconnect to the last
WiFi network it used. If it can't connect within 15 seconds, it will
switch to configuration mode automatically.


2.2 Connect to open hotspot: nmap-2.4g.


2.3 After connecting to the AP, mobile phones will automatically
redirect to the setup page while PCs require manually entering
192.168.4.1 on your browser.




                                    7
NMMiner                                       Make it better!
2.4 Configure your nmminer on this page - higher UI refresh values
boost hash rate, including when the screen is off.




2.5 You can return to the configuration page at any time and refer
to the button operations.

2.5 After saving, wait 10-15s for auto-restart (no manual reset
needed)

4 Pool reference
Limited chip resources cause high-difficulty pool rejections. Only
supported low-difficulty pools:

        Url           Type   Port    Description Minimum required difficulty
pool.nerdminers.org   tcp    3333       BTC            Minimum 0.001
public-pool.io        tcp    21496      BTC            Minimum 0.001
pool.tazmining.ch     tcp    33333      BTC            Minimum 0.001

*Note: List of available mining pools (note: we don't operate these pools -
outages may occur without notice.)

5Q&A
5.1 Miner stuck at 80%

1) Check the Mining Pool;

2) Check the BTC address used;

3) Try to update to the newest version;

5.2 Stuck at 90% because of the WiFi router

For this situation, you can try to create a 2.4G WiFi AP by your

phone, then try to reconnect the device. If works well, to try:

- For ASUS router, need to turn off the AI settings / two-way IPS;

- For some router is IEEE 802.15.4ax, change to IEEE 802.15.4 b/g/n.
